rf_policy: Use exact radio pose_id subset of full ROUTE_POSE; no H interpolation or RF at nonradio frames; radio_at_turn/scan/vertices retained
motion_truth: Published six-decimal ROUTE_POSE.csv unchanged; all motion frames used for controls and evaluation

LoS_flags: Use source LOS_EXISTS.npy or explicit radio CSV los_exists field, preserve false rows; missing flags BLOCKED_INPUT
identity: Verify extracted-file receipt hashes before sensor generation; duplicates accepted only when byte-identical; radio geometry/time must equal motion pose_id rows
baseline_target: BASELINE.csv seed0 canonical; seeds0-4 ranges explicitly motion-noise-repeat including original initial-error stream; previous F/crosscase comparisons row-wise
scientific_independence: C01-C03 and legacy routes share one corridor scene; O01-O03 share one office scene; no independent-condition p-values
